title: [Bug]: Cannot serve a Qwen3-VL sequence classification model with num_labels > 2 (multi-label classification)
author: TonyUSTC

comments.author: noooop
comments.body:
I believe it can definitely work. Let's see how we can get it to run along the correct code path.


1. You need to specify {"architectures": ["Qwen3VLForSequenceClassification"]} so that it enters the as_seq_cls_model code path.
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/2afa3f7e950264bb179d030c23a1ed1f46558fd9/vllm/model_executor/models/adapters.py#L321-L329

2. **You need to find a way to make text_config.num_labels equal to 20. (code line 232 above) The code here may need some optimization to be compatible with more models.**

3. You need to specify  {"problem_type": "multi_label_classification"}' so that it enters the PoolerMultiLabelClassify code path.

https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/2afa3f7e950264bb179d030c23a1ed1f46558fd9/vllm/model_executor/layers/pooler/activations.py#L30-L36
